title: Pin changelog and files-scope edges; doctor reason and spec-check wording
lead: *Proposed.* Tests that pin the CHANGELOG resolver and the files-scope parser at their edges, one docs sentence on what the files-scope check sees after the slice commit, a doctor upgrade reason that names the tool once, and "Other spec-check errors" in the docs.
findings_note: 2026-11-17 spec draft of S230 (S180 item 2), S231 (S50 items 1 and 2) and S232 (S188 items 2 and 5) at f48a6154. `TestMergeChangelogEntries` and `TestMergeChangelogEntriesLayouts` always have a `## v1.0.0` section after Unreleased and no CRLF (`internal/engine/changelog_test.go:150-322`); `internal/engine/filescope_test.go:15-49` has no quoted path, no ` R` record and no sibling-prefix directory; the files-scope note does not say it reads `git status` only (`docs/design.md:836-842`); the doctor names slicer twice (`internal/cli/upgrade.go:211-215`); "Real spec-check failures" (`docs/guide.md:399`, `docs/design.md:2750`).

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
Owner decisions (2026-11-17): adj 438 (Q3), the files-scope warning's view after the slice commit is documented, not widened.

Re-checked at HEAD f48a6154:

- S230, S180 item 2 (CHANGELOG tests), still present. Every case in `TestMergeChangelogEntries` and `TestMergeChangelogEntriesLayouts` has a section after Unreleased (`internal/engine/changelog_test.go:151-152,196-197`) and LF line ends. The behaviour, measured with a copy of `mergeChangelogEntries` from `internal/engine/changelog.go:168-236`: with Unreleased last, base `...- old
`, ours `...- S1

- old
`, theirs `...- S2

- old
` merge to `...- S1

- S2

- old
` (no extra blank line; S180 item 3 was fixed by S327, see `.scratch/spec-S230-S232-dropped.md`); an empty last Unreleased merges `- S1
` and `- S2
` to `- S1

- S2
`; a CRLF file is refused (`ok` false), because `splitChangelog` looks for the exact line `## Unreleased` (`changelog.go:74-83`), so the conflict pause names `CHANGELOG.md` for the owner (`internal/engine/landmerge.go:100-106,163-188`).
- S231, S50 item 1 (files-scope tests), still present. `TestFilesScopeReadsOnlyChangedPaths` covers ` M`, `A `, ` D`, `??`, `R `, ` C` and `!!` (`internal/engine/filescope_test.go:43-49`); no case has a double quote in a path or a worktree-column rename ` R`, and `TestScopeWarningsNamesPathsOutsideTheList` checks a file prefix (`docs/design.md.bak`, `:15-23`) but not a sibling directory such as `internal/engine2` under an `internal/engine` entry (`internal/engine/check.go:490-517`).
- S231, S50 item 2 (files-scope after the commit), still present; the owner decided to document it (adj 438). `changedPaths` reads `git status --porcelain=v1 -z --untracked-files=all` in the worktree (`internal/engine/filescope.go:34-41`). After the slice commit, a landing fix round (`internal/engine/land.go:262-276`) runs the gate again and the warning then sees only that round's uncommitted edits. `docs/design.md:836-842` does not say so.
- S232, S188 item 2 (doctor reason), still present. With `--upgrade` the slicer reason is `requested with --upgrade (installed: ` + the first line of `slicer --version` + `)` (`internal/cli/upgrade.go:211-215`, `internal/cli/doctor.go:236-240`), and `slicer --version` prints `slicer 1.22.1` on this machine, so the line reads `[upgrade] slicer  requested with --upgrade (installed: slicer 1.22.1)` (`internal/cli/doctor.go:613`). adj prints `v1.0.0` and is not affected.
- S232, S188 item 5 (docs wording), still present: "Real spec-check failures carry the `spec check failed: ` prefix" (`docs/guide.md:399`, `docs/design.md:2750`).

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- `TestMergeChangelogEntriesUnreleasedLast` (`internal/engine/changelog_test.go`), table, prefix `# Changelog

## Unreleased

`: (a) base `P+"- old
"`, ours `P+"- S1

- old

"` want `P+"- S1

- S2

- old
"`, true; (b) base `P`, ours `P+"- S1
"`, theirs `P+"- S2
"` want `P+"- S1

- S2
"`, true; (c) base `P+"- old"` (no final newline), ours `P+"- S1

- old"`, theirs `P+"- S2

- old"` want `P+"- S1

- S2

- old"`, true. Passes on arrival for all three (measured with a copy of `mergeChangelogEntries` at f48a6154); it pins S180 item 2 and the S180 item 3 fix.
- `TestMergeChangelogEntriesRefusesCRLF`: the three sides of case (a) and of the existing "reviewer example" with every `
` replaced by `
` give `("", false)`. Passes on arrival (measured); it pins that a CRLF file goes to the owner instead of being rewritten.
- `TestFilesScopeReadsQuotedAndWorktreeRenamedPaths` (`internal/engine/filescope_test.go`): `parsePorcelainZ(" M a"b.go\x00 R new.go\x00old.go\x00")` is `[]string{"a"b.go", "new.go", "old.go"}`. Passes on arrival; pins S50 item 1.
- `TestScopeWarningsSiblingDirectoryIsOutside`: `ScopeWarnings([]string{"internal/engine2/x.go", "internal/engine/x.go"}, []string{"internal/engine"})` is `[]string{"internal/engine2/x.go"}`. Passes on arrival; pins S50 item 1.
- `TestDoctorUpgradeReasonNamesTheToolOnce` (`internal/cli/upgrade_test.go`): `buildHints` with tools `{Name: "slicer", Present: true, Version: "slicer 1.22.1"}` and `{Name: "adj", Present: true, Version: "v1.0.0"}` and `all` true gives reasons `requested with --upgrade (installed: 1.22.1)` and `requested with --upgrade (installed: v1.0.0)`. Red first: `(installed: slicer 1.22.1)`.
- `TestDoctorUpgradeReasonShowsTheInstalledVersion` (`internal/cli/upgrade_test.go:725`): its expected text strips a leading `NAME ` from the fixture version the same way.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Write the tests above; see `TestDoctorUpgradeReasonNamesTheToolOnce` red. The changelog and files-scope tests pass on arrival; if one is red, stop and report it, since the measured behaviour differs from HEAD f48a6154.
2. `internal/cli/upgrade.go`: when a version starts with the tool name and a space, drop that prefix in the `(installed: ...)` text, for slicer and adj. Do not change the `[ok]` doctor lines.
3. Docs: `docs/design.md:836-842`: add that the check reads `git status`, so after the slice commit (a landing fix round, S119) it sees only that round's uncommitted edits (*proposed*). Replace "Real spec-check failures" with "Other spec-check errors" in `docs/guide.md:399` and `docs/design.md:2750`. CHANGELOG.md: one bullet at the end of `## Unreleased`.
4. UI slice: UI pass (r14).

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
Acceptance criteria:

- A CHANGELOG whose Unreleased is the last section merges two new entries with one blank line between entries and no extra line at the end; a CRLF CHANGELOG is left to the owner.
- A path with a double quote, a worktree-column rename and a sibling directory are read and judged as the tests state.
- `docs/design.md` says what the files-scope warning sees after the slice commit.
- `ork doctor --upgrade` prints `[upgrade] slicer  requested with --upgrade (installed: 1.22.1)` with slicer 1.22.1 installed.
- The docs say "Other spec-check errors".

Commands:

- `go vet ./...` exits 0.
- `go test ./...` exits 0.
- `go test ./internal/engine -run 'Changelog|Scope' -v` and `go test ./internal/cli -run 'DoctorUpgrade' -v` list the new tests as passing.
- `gofmt -l .` prints nothing.
- `slicer check --root /home/jon/code/squalor-xyz/ork` exits 0.
- `adj lint` exits 0.
- `rg -n "Real spec-check failures" docs` prints nothing.
- `rg -n "only that round" docs/design.md` finds the files-scope sentence.
